items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: We signed a deal years ago... Plus it was Scott Hamilton’s very first record date with that company.

ctx.x: We signed a deal years ago. But we didn’t get much in front to do it, in fact they’re making more now then I made then, on occasion you know. On occasion. But I got some good guys with that company. Alfred Turner you know. But we only made one record. But it sold very big. It was one of his better selling records. Rose Clooney, Crosby, Bing Crosby. I got them all on one record. Woody, Bing, Tony, Rosemary all on one record. Plus it was Scott Hamilton’s very first record date with that company. The first record…
